verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud browser infrastructure product, but the evidence presents Hyperbrowser's core only as managed cloud sessions billed by credits. Nothing documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the browser and session platform. The open-source HyperAgent library and the GitHub MCP server are adjacent tools that sit on top of the service. They are not a self-hostable version of the core product, so they earn no credit.
